what_this_is: The exact facts a founder needs to authorize the Cincinnati deployment and launch. This order PREPARED this packet and did not consume it. No deployment authorization exists, no deployment record was created, launch participation was not touched, and nothing was deployed.

two_facts_kept_apart.why: Cincinnati is promoted in SOURCE and invisible in PRODUCTION. Those are different facts and blurring them is how a market gets launched by accident.
two_facts_kept_apart.A_source_promoted_state: Cincinnati authority now holds 130 published pet-friendly profiles and 75 verified-no-pets. This is committed and proven.
two_facts_kept_apart.B_production_candidate: The composed bundle is UNCHANGED by that promotion, because Cincinnati's launch_status excludes it from composition. Production still serves 9 markets and 656 profiles.

candidate_A_participation_as_it_stands.what_it_is: A fresh assembly of the promoted source with launch participation UNCHANGED.
candidate_A_participation_as_it_stands.conclusion: Promoting Cincinnati moved NO byte of the production bundle. Deploying this candidate would be a no-op.

candidate_B_if_the_founder_authorizes_ci.what_it_is: The exact bundle a launch decision would produce. Measured in a THROWAWAY detached worktree whose participation flip was never committed; the founder's lever in the real checkout is untouched.

file_level_delta_against_candidate_A.the_one_changed_file: sitemap.xml, which must change because it gains Cincinnati's 148 routes
file_level_delta_against_candidate_A.why_this_matters: Zero removals and zero collateral changes to existing pages. No live URL is withdrawn or rewritten.

candidate_B_if_the_founder_authorizes_ci.note_on_visibility: Cincinnati's market contract sets show_in_navigation=false and show_in_sitemap=false, yet its 148 routes DO appear in sitemap.xml. That is not a defect and not a surprise: live Louisville carries the same two flags and has 59 sitemap entries today. The flags govern the market hub's presence in global navigation listings, not whether its profile URLs are indexed.

open_items_carried_to_the_founder.subject: Cincinnati Marriott at RiverCenter is held, and its refusal is sound
open_items_carried_to_the_founder.detail: marriott.com/cvgdr states 'Pets Not Allowed' for this property. It is NOT recorded, because address_key reduces both '10 West RiverCenter Blvd.' and '10 East RiverCenter Blvd.' to '10|rivercenter|41011', so the refusal would bar the already-published Embassy Suites by Hilton Cincinnati RiverCenter at 10 East. The exclusion contract's own co_located_distinct rules the pair DISTINCT on brand-scoped property codes MARRIOTT:cvgdr vs HILTON:cvgrces.
open_items_carried_to_the_founder.instrument: a reviewed same_campus_distinct_entity resolution in identity_resolutions.json naming both identities at address_key 10|rivercenter|41011
open_items_carried_to_the_founder.why_not_done_here: authoring one is a NEW identity ruling, and this order was directed not to invent an identity judgement to reach a count

open_items_carried_to_the_founder.subject: The Cincinnatian Hotel is held by founder decision
open_items_carried_to_the_founder.detail: Its only visible evidence is 'Service animals only' beside Hilton's structured pets_allowed=false flag. This market's Great Wolf Lodge ruling already declined a bare structured flag as a refusal, and a service-animal sentence is a legal access category rather than a pet policy. Evidence and hash stay committed.

open_items_carried_to_the_founder.subject: The shared paid-attempt ledger is UNCLASSIFIED by the change-surface classifier
open_items_carried_to_the_founder.detail: launch_packages/pettripfinder/ptf_paid_attempt_ledger_001.json matches no rule in regression_delta, so it falls through to the full suite. That is the correct fail-closed default and it cost nothing here, because this order required a full regression anyway. A shared spend ledger deserves a rule of its own.
